title: Fort Lytton

terrainReference.basis: Fixed independent exterior drill-area point chosen before terrain and geometry, outside main earthwork and away from the water channel. Not a surveyed finished floor or water datum.

mapIdentity.scope: Actual main fort/casemate/moat/seven gun-pit/embankment/store/western-battery/searchlight/ruin plans; native actual fort frame, not story point in quarantine precinct. Fine sections and unmapped intrinsic traces estimated.

note: Whole surviving Fort Lytton: actual pentagonal main earthworks/open grassy court/moat/causeway and entry passage, northern and northwestern casemates with seven gun positions and defining restored artillery, engine-room/coal-store corner, two mapped southern/eastern brick stores and surviving concrete slabs. Western battery/pits5and6, WWII searchlight and command-post remnants, bounded gun-cotton-store/priming-pit ruins and1903 searchlight/old jetty/winch-block traces where primary relative information supports them. Neighbouring Lytton Quarantine Station/chimney/refinery, museum display collections unrelated to fixed positions, modern shelters/movie-set remnants/picnic equipment/boats/trees/people/inscriptions excluded. Before geometry, courtFloor2.9123m fixed from independent[45,0] source height+.15m; westernFloor1.3971m from independent pit5/6-centre samples+.15m. Individual store and searchlight levels sampled at mapped centres+.15m. Water-1.2397m from independent western-water point[-70,20]+.08m; not a surveyed tide datum. Relative court/roof/bank/pit levels are recorded medium-fi section estimates from primary architectural form. Source DEM contains earthworks/shoreline effects and does not resolve every excavation, floor or bank, so channel and hidden-section contact remains approximate. Whole court/grass banks/retaining faces are authored construction geometry over the fixed field; original16641 values/grid/PNG/four raw tiles unchanged. No flattening, fitting or reacquisition. Replacement disabled. Gun-cotton/priming pit/1903searchlight/old jetty/winch traces and T-position are explicitly unmapped relative-location estimates; no modern pontoon substituted.
